claim: The open-source janus-llm tool can translate a binary file into a programming language using Ghidra decompilation combined with LLM reasoning.
stance_target: Reverse Engineering & Codebase Mastery pillar — a concrete, installable open-source tool exists that combines automated decompilation (Ghidra) with LLM translation, directly usable in a software-factory reverse-engineering pipeline
scope_conditions: janus-llm v. as of fetch, MITRE Corporation, Apache-2.0 license
quoted_support: Translate from a binary file to a programming language using Ghidra decompilation.

claim: janus-llm chunks code across over 100 programming languages to fit different model context windows and stores chunks in a Chroma vector database, enabling RAG-based codebase ingestion at scale.
stance_target: Open Source Architecture Reading & Context Ingestion pillar — a working reference implementation for chunking and vectorizing arbitrary legacy codebases for LLM context ingestion
scope_conditions: janus-llm tool, supports 100+ languages via tree-sitter parsing
quoted_support: Chunk code of over 100 programming languages to fit within different model context windows and add to a Chroma vector database.
